title: QR Gradient Maker
spec: Design a QR code with a two-color gradient (with contrast guardrails) and export PNG/SVG; warns when contrast is unsafe.

title: QR Frame Designer
spec: Design a frame + call-to-action around a QR code (shape, text, colors); live preview and PNG export.

title: QR Quiet Zone Adder
spec: Add a correct quiet zone (white or transparent) around an uploaded QR image; exports the padded image.

title: QR SVG PNG PDF Exporter
spec: Paste any text/URL and export the QR code as SVG, PNG (multiple sizes), or a one-page PDF.

title: QR Size Presets
spec: Pick a use case (business card, flyer, poster, billboard) and get exact QR dimensions in mm/inches/px with a preview box.

title: QR Color Pair Tester
spec: Test foreground/background color pairs for scan safety: contrast ratio, verdict, and suggested fixes.

title: QR Batch Renamer
spec: Rename many downloaded QR files by pattern (prefix + counter + label) entirely in-browser, then download the ZIP.

title: QR ZIP Packager
spec: Package uploaded QR images into a ZIP with a manifest CSV (filename, payload, notes) for handoff to print.

title: QR Print Sheet Planner
spec: Plan an A4/Letter sheet: code size, margins, rows/columns, cut guides; renders a printable sheet layout.

title: QR Scan Instruction Card
spec: Generate a printable "How to scan" instruction card (iPhone + Android steps) in several languages/layouts.

title: QR Embed Code Builder
spec: Build copy-paste HTML/iframe embed code for a QR image with size, alt text, and link options.

title: QR API Playground
spec: Interactive API docs: build a QR-generation request from parameters and copy the fetch snippet; explains each parameter.

title: QR to PDF Converter
spec: Convert a QR image or text into a printable one-page PDF with title, instructions, and quiet-zone-safe margins.

title: QR Image Enhancer
spec: Enhance a blurry/low-contrast QR photo in-browser (contrast, sharpen, threshold) to make it scannable again.

title: QR Code Rotator
spec: Rotate a QR image by 90/180/270 degrees or arbitrary angle in-browser and download the result.

title: QR Code Cropper
spec: Crop a QR image in-browser with a quiet-zone guard that warns if the crop would cut the margin.

title: QR Call to Action Builder
spec: Write and style a call-to-action line for a QR code (text, arrow, urgency) with a live preview card.

title: QR Analytics Simulator
spec: Enter your own assumptions (prints, scan rate, conversion); see projected scans/conversions math with every formula shown.

title: QR A/B Test Planner
spec: Plan a QR A/B test: variants, sample sizes, success metric, and a printable test plan with decision rules.

title: QR Campaign Planner
spec: Plan a QR campaign: goals, placements, quantities, timeline, and QA steps; exports a printable campaign brief.
